assumptions: Inherited core tally qualifications remain. This tally updates the explicit AIC2026 adapter; source_commit pins the inherited core analysis, and the adapter source is in the accompanying AIC refusal receipt.
Explicit AIC route computes only integer Y on the even crop; no unused chroma planes. Three integer multiplies, four adds and two shifts per pixel; float FLOPs are zero for ingress.
bit_depth 8 -> samples shifted <<2 to 10-bit (cambi.rs:5871-5887) AND anti_dithering_filter runs (bit_depth<10, cambi.rs:5888-5890): in-place 2x2 u16 mean per px (cambi.rs:4422+,4597 comment).

Pipeline (cambi.rs:5900-5980): get_spatial_mask (derivative rows + rolling DP column sums over 7x7, MASK_FILTER_SIZE=7, cambi.rs:5116-5279) -> per scale of NUM_SCALES=5: decimate(img)+decimate(mask) 2x2 box -> filter_mode 3x3 mode via 3-row buffer (mode3 horizontal into buffer then mode3 vertical into data, cambi.rs:4802+,4597-4660) -> calculate_c_values -> spatial_pooling top-60% -> weighted by SCALE_WEIGHTS [16,8,4,2,1] / win^2.

calculate_c_values (cambi.rs:5409-5620): per output row, one image row ENTERS and one LEAVES the sliding window; each entering px range-updates `window` output columns in histograms_acc[band x W] (u16 += delta, cambi_range_update). Per out px ~= 2*window int updates. Then per px: mask check, band clamp, and num_diffs=4 (MAX_LOG_CONTRAST=2) gather+cmp+weight loop over the local histogram (cambi.rs:5279-5400).

window_size = adjust_window_size(65, w,h,speedup): ((65*(w+h))/375)>>4, halved when speedup (w*h>=1920*1080 AND v1_preset... note: v1_preset=false for standalone cambi_from_luma so speedup=false always here; window ~23 at 1024^2, ~67 at 4K). Model uses the non-speedup formula; window stays FIXED across scales (in scaled px) so halo doubles per level.
speedup path (scale0 at half res) requires v1_preset=true; standalone CAMBI never takes it - all 5 scales evaluated at ceil(W/2^l) x ceil(H/2**l).
Ops dominated by u16/i32 histogram maintenance: counted as int+cmp (tracked separately from flops like VMAF's fixed-point path).
CAMBI_MIN_WIDTH_HEIGHT=216: both dims >=216 required (well, not both <216).

stages.name: swscale integer Y only
stages.notes: y = round(16 + 219*(0.299r+0.587g+0.114b)/255) clamped [16,235]. cb/cr also computed at W*H/4 each but unused by cambi (ingress shares the VMAF routine) - counted in cbcr601 as implementation waste.

stages.name: in-place 2x2 u16 mean (bit_depth<10)
stages.notes: In-place overlapping 2x2: (a+b+c+d+2)>>2-ish wrapping adds; reads ahead of write per row.

stages.name: derivative rows + rolling DP col sums + 7x7 mask threshold
stages.notes: derivative_row (|v[x]-v[x-1]| per row) into rolling dp ring of 2*pad+2 rows; each output px = DP row add + clamp + threshold -> mask u16. Bounded dp buffer (dp_height=2*pad+2 rows) -> strip.

stages.name: 2x2 u16 box decimate image+mask (in-place)
stages.notes: Runs at scale>0 (scale0 is full res for non-speedup path). Both image and mask decimated - 2x elements.

stages.name: 3x3 mode filter (mode3 h into 3-row buffer, mode3 v into image)
stages.notes: Row-horizontal mode3 buffered (3 rows), vertical mode3 writes image in place: 2x mode3 per px. Mode of 3 u16 = compare/select network.

stages.name: sliding-window histogram update + 4-bin diff gathers
stages.notes: int term = 2*window (enter+leave range updates over window cols per px) + ~14 per-px band/clamp/gather-address int ops; window=((65*(w+h))/375)>>4|1 ~23@1024. Per-px c_value: mask check + band clamp + p0 gather + 4x(2 gathers+cmp+weighted fma). histograms_acc = band_size x W u16 planes (full).

stages.name: top-60% partition + mean of c_values
stages.notes: nth-element-style partition to 60% + f64 mean of survivors; c_values mutated in place.
